title: 第22章 接受难民第23章 难民处理
slug: 领主反派破灭后开始当战犯
content_zh:
“大人，请你收留我们吧！”
看见林恩回头，那位大叔立刻跪倒在地上。
林恩之前还在这个家伙那里买了奴隶，现在怎么就来求他了？
“好了，你先喝口水吧，慢慢说。”林恩无奈道。
那位大叔已经开口了：“大人啊，兽人入侵了，现在要塞以外都是兽人，要塞今年收留的人太多了，我们已经无处可去了。”
“你们有粮食吗？”林恩立刻理解情况，马上询问起对方的情况。
“大人要是想要粮食的话，我们有，我们有，我们把身家都带上了。”对方的语速很快，生怕林恩嫌弃。
“让我先看看你们情况吧。”林恩小伙起立了，免费的人口，能拿就拿。
......
城外，虽然还没下雪，但也是寒风呼啸，这个天气，除了林恩，莉莉姆，艾克雷这些有魔法或者斗气的人外，剩下的人穿的那叫一个厚。
林恩还没走到城门就听见了人山人海的嘈杂声，自己的人在跟城外的人貌似在对峙。
由于阿宁斯贝城最初就是军事作用的，加上需要快速修建了，阿宁斯贝城是很小的，不然根本守不住。
因此，只留了一个城门，其他地方都是不留城门的，自己的城堡则是到现在也没修好，只是在木头城堡在外面盖了点砖头，二楼，三楼都还是木制的露出外面。
城堡里面有个隔间挖了三条地道通往外面，方便逃跑。
阿宁斯贝的城由于是中式城墙，同时十分的厚，6米土，两米砖头，加上瓮城。
林恩设计了3道门。
刚刚登上城墙，林恩就绷不住了，人山人海。
不是，那么多人，这是来攻城的是吧？
林恩在心里吐槽了一句，看着下面的人。
他们每个人都带了粮食，确实有粮。

自己的城墙上也是站满了人，艾克雷把所有人都动员了起来，人人手里拿着长矛，背后还背着七八跟标枪，腰上挂着投矛器，有的人穿着皮甲，有的人没有甲的穿，有的人身上居然自己整了一套木甲？
艾克雷此时还对着下面的人吼道：“都给我安静点！”
“保持冷静！”
“等你们的代表和大统领沟通！”
格雷身边有着几个老头，格雷看见林恩登上城墙后，也是立刻把那几个老头领了过来。
“大统领，这些难民都是跑的快的，不过老弱妇孺居多，他们的男人都抵抗兽人生死不明了，不过根据目测以及现在村长的口供来看，还有一批没成年的男性在里面，不过这些人群里也有一些老鼠在。”
老鼠，形容地痞流氓无赖的。
“大人，求求你了，收留我们吧。”所有人异口同声道。
这个时候其他人也进行了求情，安娜看了一眼那个奴隶商贩，才跪下来求林恩：“大人，求求你了，这里面还有我的母亲，她还怀了个孩子，我妹妹才几岁，我姐姐也怀了孩子。”
【魔法.眺望】一种加强视力的魔法，多数情况下用于侦查。
所有人确实携带了粮食，不过看样子肯定不够，有的人带的多，有的人带的少，难办啊。
还有一些老鼠在里面，干坏事啊。
“收留你们也不是不可能，不过我讨厌不服从的人。”林恩一边说着，手里出现魔杖，瞄准了下方一个偷偷摸摸鬼鬼祟祟的人。
魔法的光芒吸引了人们的目光，同时林恩的话也让那些求收留的人燃了一些希望。
【魔法.土锥术】土刺在空中形成，随后如此利箭一样向前突刺，直接命中了几个老鼠。
几十米的距离，魔法的最佳范围。
content_en:
"Sir, please take us in!"
When Lin En turned around, the uncle immediately knelt down on the ground.
Linn bought a slave from this guy before, why is she begging him now?
"Okay, take a drink of water first and speak slowly." Lin En said helplessly.
The uncle had already spoken: "Sir, the orcs have invaded. Now there are orcs outside the fortress. The fortress has taken in too many people this year, and we have nowhere to go."
"Do you have food?" Lin En immediately understood the situation and asked about the other party's situation.
"If you want food, sir, we have it. We have it. We have brought all our wealth with us." The other party spoke quickly, for fear that Lin En would dislike it.
"Let me take a look at your situation first." Young man Lin En stood up. Free people, you can take them if you can.
...
Outside the city, although it hasn't snowed yet, the wind is still howling. In this weather, except for people with magic or fighting spirit such as Linn, Lilim, and Aikere, the rest of the people are wearing thick clothes.
Before Lin En reached the city gate, he heard the noise of a huge crowd of people. His own people seemed to be confronting the people outside the city.
Since the city of Aningsbey was initially used for military purposes, and it needed to be built quickly, the city of Aningsbey was very small, otherwise it would not have been defended at all.
Therefore, only one city gate was left, and no city gates were left in other places. The castle itself has not been repaired yet. It just built some bricks on the outside of the wooden castle. The second and third floors are still wooden and exposed.
There is a compartment inside the castle with three tunnels dug to the outside to facilitate escape.
The city of Aninsbey has a Chinese-style city wall and is very thick, with 6 meters of soil, 2 meters of bricks, and an urn.
Lynn designed 3 doors.
As soon as he climbed onto the city wall, Lin En couldn't hold himself any longer. There were so many people.
No, there are so many people here to attack the city, right?
Lin En complained in his mind and looked at the people below.
Each of them brought food, and there was indeed food.
His own city wall was also full of people. Aikere mobilized everyone. Everyone had a spear in their hand, seven or eight javelins on their backs, and spear throwers hanging on their waists. Some people were wearing leather armor, some were wearing no armor, and some people actually had a set of wooden armor on their bodies?
At this time, Aikeli yelled at the people below: "Please be quiet!"
"Keep calm!"
"Wait for your representatives to communicate with the commander-in-chief!"
There were several old men beside Gray. After Gray saw Lin En climbing the city wall, he immediately led the old men over.
"Commander, these refugees are all fast runners, but most of them are old, weak, women and children. Their men are resisting the orcs and their life and death are unknown. However, according to visual inspection and the current confession of the village chief, there are still a group of underage males inside, but there are also some rats in these groups."
Rat refers to ruffians and scoundrels.
"Sir, please, please take us in." Everyone said in unison.
At this time, others also begged for mercy. Anna glanced at the slave trader, then knelt down and begged Linn: "Sir, please, there is my mother here, and she is pregnant with a child. My sister is only a few years old, and my sister is also pregnant with a child."
[Magic. Vision] A magic that enhances vision and is used for detection in most cases.
Everyone did bring food, but it looked like it was definitely not enough. Some people brought more, while others brought less. It was difficult to handle.
There are some rats inside, doing bad things.
"It's not impossible to take you in, but I hate disobedient people." Linn said, a wand appeared in his hand, aiming at a sneaky person below.
The light of magic attracted people's attention, and at the same time, Linn's words also gave some hope to those who asked for shelter.
[Magic. Earth Cone Technique] Earth spikes are formed in the air, and then thrust forward like a sharp arrow, directly hitting several mice.
A distance of tens of meters is the optimal range for magic.
